items.question: What was the average resolution time in hours of support tickets by region in 2026?
items.sql:
SELECT r.code AS region_code, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.resolved_at - t.created_at) / 3600) AS avg_hours
FROM support_tickets t JOIN regions r ON r.id = t.region_id
WHERE t.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND t.created_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.created_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY r.code
items.answer: Result: region code LATAM, avg hours 40.06; region code NA, avg hours 35.70; region code APAC, avg hours 42.56 (5 rows; first 3 shown).

items.question: How many refunds with the reason 'defective' did each product category have in 2025?
items.sql:
SELECT cat.name AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS refunds
FROM refunds rf JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rf.order_item_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = rf.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE rf.reason = 'defective' AND NOT c.is_test_account
  AND rf.refunded_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND rf.refunded_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY cat.name
items.answer: Result: category name Batteries, refunds 9; category name Cables & Adapters, refunds 18; category name Hubs & Bridges, refunds 13 (10 rows; first 3 shown).

items.question: How many orders were paid with each payment method in 2026 so far, counting successful payments only?

WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND NOT c.is_test_account AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY p.method
items.answer: Result: method apple_pay, orders 1,331; method bank_transfer, orders 658; method card, orders 6,850 (4 rows; first 3 shown).

items.question: Show net revenue for each month of 2026 with the difference in USD from the previous month
items.sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', ordered_at) AS month, SUM(net_revenue_usd) AS net_revenue_usd FROM order_revenue
  WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month, net_revenue_usd, net_revenue_usd - LAG(net_revenue_usd) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS diff_usd
FROM m ORDER BY month OFFSET 1

items.question: Of the customers whose first order was in January 2025, how many ordered again within 90 days of that first order?

FROM customer_profile p JOIN order_revenue r ON r.customer_id = p.customer_id
WHERE p.first_order_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND p.first_order_at < DATE '2025-02-01'
  AND r.ordered_at > p.first_order_at AND r.ordered_at <= p.first_order_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
items.answer: Result: repeat customers 127.

items.question: For each first-order month in 2025, how many new customers were there and how many of them placed another order within 60 days?
items.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', p.first_order_at) AS cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS new_customers,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM order_revenue r WHERE r.customer_id = p.customer_id
           AND r.ordered_at > p.first_order_at AND r.ordered_at <= p.first_order_at + INTERVAL '60 days'
       )) AS repeat_within_60_days
FROM customer_profile p
WHERE p.first_order_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND p.first_order_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
items.answer: Result: cohort month 2025-01-01T00:00:00+00:00, new customers 366, repeat within 60 days 91; cohort month 2025-02-01T00:00:00+00:00, new customers 287, repeat within 60 days 72; cohort month 2025-03-01T00:00:00+00:00, new customers 384, repeat within 60 days 100 (12 rows; first 3 shown).

items.question: How much was refunded in USD for damaged-in-transit reasons in each EU country, for refunds issued in calendar Q3 2026?

WHERE r.code = 'EU' AND rf.reason = 'damaged_in_transit'

GROUP BY o.country_code
